title: Correction: Orvan corridor agreement was not renewed

facts.subject: Orvan corridor agreement
facts.statement: The report that the Corridor Agreement had been renewed was wrong.

source_ref.text_snippet: On 9 September we reported that the Corridor Agreement had been renewed. That report was wrong.

facts.subject: Orvan corridor agreement
facts.statement: The agreement expired on 10 September without a renewal.

source_ref.text_snippet: The agreement expired on 10 September without a renewal.

facts.subject: Orvan corridor agreement
facts.statement: Talks ended without a signed replacement.

source_ref.text_snippet: Talks ended without a signed replacement.

facts.subject: Orvan corridor agreement
facts.statement: The original story should not be relied on.

source_ref.text_snippet: The original story should not be relied on.

facts.subject: sea exports
facts.statement: Sea exports now move under the general rules.

source_ref.text_snippet: The correct position is that sea exports now move under the general rules.

[P1] On 9 September we reported that the Corridor Agreement had been renewed. That report was wrong....
[P2] The agreement expired on 10 September without a renewal. Talks ended without a signed replacement....
[P3] The error appeared in an early edition and was repeated by other outlets. We have removed the report from our wire ...
